classPractice.question: The guests were ____ (royal) entertained at the palace.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 entertained 用副词 royally'隆重地'。

classPractice.question: 学习没有捷径。
classPractice.answer: There is no royal road to learning.
classPractice.note: 谚语；royal road 捷径。

translation: n. 坟墓
original_sentence: On his deathbed, he asked to be buried in China, and in line with his will the emperor built a tomb for him.
definitionEn: a place or structure in which a dead person is buried

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 坟墓，陵墓（尤指地面上有石碑或建筑结构的，常用于帝王、名人）
uncommonMeanings.example: the tomb of the emperor 皇帝的陵墓

posExamples.sentence: Archaeologists opened the ancient tomb carefully. （课堂例句·考古学家小心地打开了古墓。）
The emperor's tomb remained hidden for centuries. （课堂例句·皇帝陵墓隐匿了数百年。）
A stone passage led into the tomb. （课堂例句·一条石砌通道通向墓室。）

wordForms.noun: tomb 坟墓；tombstone 墓碑
wordForms.other: 发音 /tuːm/，b 不发音（同类：comb, bomb, climb, debt, doubt）；复数 tombs

collocations.translation: 为某人修建坟墓（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In line with his will the emperor built a tomb for him. 按照他的遗嘱，皇帝为他修了坟墓。
On his deathbed, he asked to be buried in China. 临终时他请求葬在中国。

collocations.translation: 按照某人的遗嘱（课文原句词块；in line with 与……一致）
collocations.example: The funeral was held in line with her will. 葬礼按她的遗嘱举行。
An ancient tomb was discovered in the city. 城里发现了一座古墓。
The Ming Tombs lie north of Beijing. 明十三陵位于北京以北。
Guards sealed the tomb entrance. 守卫封住了墓门。
Paintings covered the tomb chamber. 壁画覆盖着墓室。
Workers discovered a tomb beneath the road. 工人在道路下发现一座墓葬。

synonyms.example: He visits his father's grave every year. 他每年去扫父亲的墓。
synonyms.usage: grave 最常用，指地下墓穴；tomb 较正式，多指有建筑或石碑的陵墓（帝王、名人）。

synonyms.example: She was buried in the local cemetery. 她葬在当地公墓。
synonyms.usage: cemetery/graveyard 指'墓地'这一场所（graveyard 常附属教堂），不指单个坟墓，不能说 build a cemetery for him。

advancedExpressions.expression: on one's deathbed 临终时 / be buried in 安葬于 / in line with one's will 遵照遗嘱 / hold a funeral 举行葬礼
advancedExpressions.example: He asked to be buried in China. 他请求葬在中国。

advancedExpressions.expression: tomb+stone→tombstone 墓碑；tomb raider 盗墓者
advancedExpressions.example: The tombstone records his life. 墓碑记载了他的生平。

advancedExpressions.expression: the Ming Tombs 明十三陵 / the tomb of Emperor Qinshihuang 秦始皇陵
advancedExpressions.example: Terracotta Warriors guard the tomb of Emperor Qinshihuang. 兵马俑守卫着秦始皇陵。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Archaeologists carefully opened the ancient burial place.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Archaeologists opened the ancient tomb carefully.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 tomb 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The emperor's burial chamber remained hidden for centuries.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The emperor's tomb remained hidden for centuries.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 tomb 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: 按照他的遗嘱，皇帝为他修建了一座坟墓。____ ____ ____ his will, the emperor built a ____ for him.
classPractice.note: 出自课文；in line with 与……一致，按照。

classPractice.question: ① The emperor's ____ took years to build. ② She was buried in the town ____.
classPractice.note: tomb 指帝王等的陵墓；cemetery 指墓地（场所）。

classPractice.question: 临终时，他请求被葬在中国。
classPractice.answer: On his deathbed, he asked to be buried in China.
classPractice.note: 出自课文；on one's deathbed 临终时。

translation: adj. 文学的，文学上的；爱好文学的
original_sentence: He learnt Chinese classics from great literary masters, and at the age of 20, he began travelling extensively across the country.
definitionEn: connected with literature or the writing and study of books; having a style suited to literature

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 文学的，文学上的（基本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: literary criticism 文学批评

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 爱好文学的，从事文学的
uncommonMeanings.example: a literary man 文人

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （词语、文体）书面的，文绉绉的
uncommonMeanings.example: a literary word 书面语词

posExamples.sentence: The city has a rich literary tradition. （课堂例句·这座城市有深厚的文学传统。）
She won an important literary prize. （课堂例句·她获得了一项重要文学奖。）
The essay uses several literary devices. （课堂例句·这篇文章运用了多种文学手法。）

wordForms.noun: literature 文学；文献（works of literature 文学作品）；【课件】literacy 读写能力（basic literacy skills 基本读写能力）
wordForms.adjective: literary 文学的；【课件】literate 有读写能力的，有文化的（反义 illiterate 不识字的）；literal 字面的
wordForms.other: 重音在第一音节 /ˈlɪtərəri/；词根 liter-=letter（字母）

collocations.translation: 伟大的文学大师（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He learnt Chinese classics from great literary masters. 他师从文学大师们学习中国典籍。
She teaches literary criticism at college. 她在大学教文学批评。
Su Shi was a great literary man. 苏轼是一位大文人。
His literary works are widely read. 他的文学作品被广泛阅读。
Modern writers draw on this literary tradition. 现代作家借鉴这一文学传统。
Her novel won a major literary award. 她的小说获得重要文学奖。

translation: adj. 杰出的，优秀的；异常的，罕见的

wordForms.noun: shelf（复数 shelves）；bookshelf 书架（复数 bookshelves）
wordForms.verb: shelve 把……放上架子；搁置，缓办（计划等）（shelved, shelved）
wordForms.other: 构词法：f→ves 变复数：shelf→shelves（同 leaf→leaves, wolf→wolves, thief→thieves）；动词是 shelve（加e），如 The plan was shelved. 计划被搁置了。

idioms.example: The proposal has been left on the shelf for years. 这项提议被搁置多年。
You can buy this software off the shelf. 这种软件可以买现成的。

idioms.translation: 保质期；持续有效的时间
idioms.example: Canned food has a long shelf life. 罐头食品保质期长。

collocations.translation: 在最上层/最下层架子上
collocations.example: The dictionary is on the top shelf. 词典在最上层架子上。

collocations.phrase: put sth back on the shelf
collocations.example: Please put the book back on the shelf. 请把书放回架子上。
He has a whole shelf of history books. 他有整整一架子历史书。
Fresh milk has a short shelf life. 鲜奶保质期很短。
The new product soon appeared on supermarket shelves. 新产品很快出现在超市货架上。
He took the logbook off the shelf. 他从架上取下日志。
New editions filled the shelves. 新版本摆满书架。
The larger format needs more shelf space. 大开本需要更多架位。

synonyms.example: Put your luggage on the rack. 把行李放到行李架上。
synonyms.usage: shelf 指固定在墙上或柜子里的'搁板'，上面平放物品；rack 指带格子、挂钩或横杆的'架'（luggage rack 行李架、towel rack 毛巾架），物品多为挂放或插放。

synonyms.example: A lamp stood on the narrow ledge.
synonyms.usage: shelf 是家具或墙上供存放物品的搁板；ledge 是墙面、窗边或悬崖突出的窄平台。

advancedExpressions.expression: on the shelf 被搁置 / off the shelf 现成的 / shelf life 保质期 / bookshelf 书架 / continental shelf 大陆架
advancedExpressions.example: New books soon filled the empty shelves. 新书很快摆满了空书架。

advancedExpressions.expression: shelf→shelves；类推 leaf→leaves, wolf→wolves, knife→knives；对应动词 shelve（搁置）
advancedExpressions.example: There are two shelves of novels above the desk. 书桌上方有两层小说。

advancedExpressions.expression: shelve a plan = put a plan on the shelf = put off / postpone a plan
advancedExpressions.example: The project was shelved for lack of money. 项目因缺钱被搁置。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Heavy boxes should go on the lowest board of the bookcase.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Heavy boxes should go on the lowest shelf.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 shelf 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Several boards collapsed under the weight.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Several shelves collapsed under the weight.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 shelf 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: There are two ____ (shelf) of books about the Industrial Revolution in the library.
classPractice.note: f→ves 变复数：shelf→shelves。

classPractice.question: 由于缺少资金，这个项目被搁置了。(shelve)
classPractice.answer: The project was shelved for lack of money.
classPractice.note: shelve 作动词'搁置'，也可说 was put on the shelf。

classPractice.question: 牛奶保质期很短，所以要放在冰箱里。Milk has a short ____ ____, so keep it in the fridge.
classPractice.note: shelf life 保质期，固定搭配。

translation: vt. & vi. vt. 采用，采取；表决采纳；领养，收养 vi. 领养，收养
original_sentence: The authors adopt a natural, chatty style of writing that opens up the subject matter to the ordinary reader.
definitionEn: to begin using an idea or method; to legally take another person's child into one's family

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 采用，采取（方法、态度、政策等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The authors adopt a natural, chatty style of writing. 作者们采用了自然、闲谈式的文风。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 表决采纳，正式通过（决议、议案等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The resolution was adopted by 90 votes to 5. 决议以90票对5票获得通过。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 领养，收养
uncommonMeanings.example: They were unable to have children and chose to adopt. 他们不能生育，选择了领养。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 摆出，呈现出（某种神态、语气）
uncommonMeanings.example: He adopted an air of indifference. 他摆出一副满不在乎的样子。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 起用，采用（名字、习俗、国籍等）
uncommonMeanings.example: He adopted an English name after moving abroad. 移居国外后他起了个英文名。

posExamples.sentence: The committee adopted the proposal unanimously. （课堂例句·委员会一致通过了提案。）
Many schools have adopted digital textbooks. （课堂例句·许多学校已采用数字教材。）
They chose to adopt an older child from care. （课堂例句·他们选择收养一名年龄较大的受助儿童。）

wordForms.noun: adoption 采用；收养（【课件】拓展词形）
wordForms.verb: adopt 采用，采取；表决采纳；领养，收养（adopted, adopted）
wordForms.adjective: adopted 被收养的（an adopted son 养子）；adoptive 收养他人的（adoptive parents 养父母）
wordForms.other: 词形贴士：adopted 修饰'被收养的孩子'，adoptive 修饰'收养方父母'；形近词 adapt（适应；改编）勿混淆。

collocations.phrase: adopt a natural, chatty style of writing
collocations.translation: 课文原句：采用自然、闲谈式的文风
collocations.example: The authors adopt a natural, chatty style of writing that opens up the subject matter to the ordinary reader. 作者们采用自然、闲谈式的文风，让普通读者也能读懂这一主题。

collocations.phrase: adopt a more analytical and serious approach to studying history
collocations.translation: 采取更具分析性、更严肃的方法来研究历史（课文另一句）
collocations.example: Contrary to popular history books, most academic books tend to adopt a more analytical and serious approach to studying history. 与通俗历史书相反，多数学术书籍倾向于采取更具分析性、更严肃的方法来研究历史。

collocations.translation: 【课件】采用（处理某事的）方法；to 是介词
collocations.example: In no way am I going to adopt this approach to the problem. 我绝不会采用这种处理问题的方法。
The UN has adopted a resolution calling on all parties to seek a settlement. 联合国通过决议呼吁各方寻求解决方案。

collocations.translation: 【课件】摆出一副满不在乎的样子
collocations.example: He adopted an air of indifference. 他摆出一副满不在乎的样子。
The government adopted a new policy on education. 政府采取了新的教育政策。
The couple decided to adopt a child. 这对夫妇决定领养一个孩子。
The committee adopted a neutral position. 委员会采取中立立场。

synonyms.example: It took him a while to adapt to the new school. 他过了一段时间才适应新学校。
synonyms.usage: 拼写辨析：adopt 采用/收养，及物（adopt an approach / a child）；adapt 适应（adapt to+名词，不及物）或改编（adapt a novel for a film，及物）。记忆：o→'拿来用'，a→'改了用'。

synonyms.example: The writer employs humour to engage readers. 作者运用幽默吸引读者。
synonyms.usage: employ/use a method 与 adopt a method 义近；adopt 强调'开始正式采用'，employ 偏'使用'，语体更正式。

synonyms.example: She took up the suggestion at once. 她立刻采纳了这个建议。
synonyms.usage: take up 口语化，还可指'开始（爱好）'；adopt 用于方法、政策、态度等更正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: adopt an approach/a method/a policy/an attitude/a resolution/an air of... 采取方法/政策/态度，通过决议，摆出神态
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to popular books, academic books adopt a serious approach. 与通俗书不同，学术书采用严肃的方法。

advancedExpressions.expression: adopt an approach 采取方法 / adapt to change 适应变化 / adapt a novel 改编小说
advancedExpressions.example: We must adapt to the market and adopt new strategies. 我们必须适应市场并采取新策略。

advancedExpressions.expression: In no way + 助动词 + 主语（否定副词短语置于句首引起部分倒装，课件例句）
advancedExpressions.example: In no way am I going to adopt this approach to the problem. 我绝不会采用这种处理问题的方法。

advancedExpressions.expression: adopt → adoption（n.）→ adopted / adoptive（adj.）
advancedExpressions.example: The adoption of new technology raised output. 新技术的采用提高了产量。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The committee formally accepted the proposal unanimously.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The committee adopted the proposal unanimously.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 adopt 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many schools have begun using digital textbooks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Many schools have adopted digital textbooks.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 adopt 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: 我绝不会采用这种处理问题的方法。（用 in no way 置于句首）
classPractice.answer: In no way am I going to adopt this approach to the problem.
classPractice.note: 否定副词短语 in no way 置句首，句子部分倒装；adopt an approach to sth 中 to 是介词。

classPractice.question: 联合国已通过一项决议，呼吁各方寻求解决方案。The UN has ____ ____ ____ calling on all parties to seek a settlement.
classPractice.note: adopt a resolution 表决通过一项决议。

classPractice.question: 用 adopt/adapt 的适当形式填空：It took the workers time to ____ to the machines, so the factory ____ a new training method.
classPractice.note: adapt to 适应；adopt a method 采取方法。

classPractice.question: The ____ (adopt) of steam power marked the beginning of the Industrial Revolution.
classPractice.note: 冠词 the 后接名词 adoption。

translation: n. 对比；比较
definitionEn: the act of examining similarities and differences; a statement showing one thing is like another

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对比，比较（找异同）
uncommonMeanings.example: She made a comparison between the two books. 她对两本书作了比较。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 比拟，比喻（把A比作B，comparison to）
uncommonMeanings.example: The comparison of life to a voyage is common in poems. 把人生比作航行在诗歌中很常见。

posExamples.sentence: The two plans invite careful comparison. （课堂例句·这两个方案值得仔细比较。）
By comparison, the second route is shorter. （课堂例句·相比之下，第二条路线更短。）
The first design looks crude by comparison. （课堂例句·相比之下，第一个设计显得粗糙。）

wordForms.noun: comparison 比较
wordForms.verb: compare 比较（compare A with/to B）
wordForms.adjective: comparative 比较的；相对的（【课件】拓展词形）；comparable 可相比的（be comparable to/with）
wordForms.other: 发音贴士：comparison 重音在第二音节 /kəmˈpærɪsn/，元音与 compare /kəmˈpeə(r)/ 不同；拼写注意 -ison 结尾。

collocations.phrase: make/draw a comparison between A and B
collocations.example: The author draws a comparison between the two dynasties. 作者对这两个朝代作了比较。

collocations.translation: 【课件】相比之下（多独立置于句首）
collocations.example: By comparison, academic books are more serious. 相比之下，学术书籍更严肃。
In comparison with the past, travel is much easier now. 与过去相比，现在旅行容易多了。

collocations.phrase: there is no comparison between A and B
collocations.translation: A和B无法相比，不可同日而语
collocations.example: There is no comparison between the two museums. 这两家博物馆没法相比。
Zheng He's fleet was beyond comparison at that time. 郑和的船队在当时无与伦比。
The new edition compares favourably with the old. 新版比旧版更好。
A direct comparison reveals the difference. 直接比较可看出差别。
The original text is included for comparison. 原文附上供比较。

synonyms.example: The contrast between the rich and the poor was sharp. 贫富对比十分鲜明。
synonyms.usage: comparison 比较异同均可；contrast 只强调'差异'。句式上都可说 by comparison / by contrast 相比之下、in comparison with / in contrast to 与……相比。

synonyms.example: The task is relatively easy. 这项任务相对容易。
synonyms.usage: 课件明确 comparatively = relatively，都作副词修饰形容词/副词：comparatively/relatively easy。

advancedExpressions.expression: make/draw a comparison between A and B；by comparison；in comparison with；beyond comparison；there is no comparison between...
advancedExpressions.example: In comparison with popular books, academic works are analytical. 与通俗读物相比，学术著作更具分析性。

advancedExpressions.expression: by comparison = in comparison = by contrast = comparatively speaking
advancedExpressions.example: By contrast, the second voyage was much longer. 相比之下，第二次航行长得多。

advancedExpressions.expression: A third reason is (that) + 从句：be 动词后接 that 引导的表语从句，that 不可省略为佳（课件练习句即此结构）
advancedExpressions.example: A third reason is that social intelligence develops in children before their general cognitive skills. 第三个原因是儿童的社交智能先于一般认知能力发展。

advancedExpressions.expression: compare(v.) → comparison(n.) → comparative(adj.) → comparatively(adv.)；comparable 可比的
advancedExpressions.example: The figures are not comparable with last year's. 这些数字无法与去年的相比。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The two plans should be compared carefully.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The two plans invite careful comparison.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 comparison 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Compared with the first route, the second is shorter.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By comparison, the second route is shorter.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 comparison 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: A third reason is that social intelligence develops in children before their general cognitive skills, at least when ____ (compare) with chimps.
classPractice.note: when (they are) compared with... 状语从句省略主语和be动词，用过去分词；主句 is 后为表语从句。

classPractice.question: 与通俗历史书相比，这本书采取了更严肃的方法。____ ____ ____ popular history books, this book adopts a more serious approach.
classPractice.note: in comparison with... 与……相比；也可用 Compared with。

classPractice.question: Life in the industrial cities was ____ (comparative) hard for child workers.
classPractice.note: 修饰形容词 hard 用副词 comparatively（= relatively）。

classPractice.question: 作者对这两座城市作了比较。(draw a comparison)
classPractice.answer: The author drew a comparison between the two cities.
classPractice.note: make/draw a comparison between A and B。

translation: vt. & vi. & n. vt. & vi. 塞进，挤进；装（箱），收拾；打包；包装 n. 包，包裹；小盒，小包
definitionEn: to put things into a container for transport; to fill a place tightly; a wrapped group of items

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 装（箱），收拾行李；打包，包装
uncommonMeanings.example: She packed her clothes for the trip. 她为旅行收拾好了衣服。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 塞进，挤进；（人群）挤满（某地）
uncommonMeanings.example: We all packed together into one car. 我们全都挤进了一辆车。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 小盒，小包
uncommonMeanings.example: He bought a pack of cards. 他买了一副纸牌。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一群（猎犬、狼等；贬义指一伙人）
uncommonMeanings.example: A pack of wolves hunted in the forest. 一群狼在森林里捕猎。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （背负的）包，背包
uncommonMeanings.example: The soldier carried a heavy pack. 士兵背着沉重的背包。

posExamples.sentence: Pack warm clothes for the voyage. （课堂例句·为这次航行收拾些保暖衣物。）
Fans packed the small stadium. （课堂例句·球迷挤满了小体育场。）
She bought a pack of cards. （课堂例句·她买了一副纸牌。）

wordForms.noun: pack 包；一群 / package 包裹；一揽子（【课件】a pay/salary package 薪酬待遇）/ packet 小包，小袋 / packing 打包；包装材料
wordForms.verb: pack 打包；挤满 / package 包装（【课件】package 可作 n./v.）/ unpack 打开（行李、包裹）
wordForms.adjective: packed 挤满的；收拾好行李的 / packaged 包装好的（【课件】packaged food 包装食品）
wordForms.other: 词族贴士：package 兼作动词'把……包装（出售）'；packet 常指小袋（a packet of crisps）；do the packing 收拾行李。

idioms.example: Don't believe him—it's a pack of lies. 别信他——那是一派谎言。
We packed up and left the campsite. 我们收拾好东西离开了营地。
He packed in his job last month. 他上个月辞掉了工作。

collocations.example: I'm all packed and ready to go. 我行李全收拾好了，随时可以出发。
Pack a few warm clothes into your suitcase. 装几件厚衣服在行李箱里。
The book is packed with information. 这本书信息丰富。
The goods were packed tightly in the box. 货物紧紧地压在箱子里。
A pack of journalists waited outside. 一群记者在外面等着。
Fans packed the hall to see the band. 歌迷挤满大厅看乐队演出。
Pack the fragile compass carefully. 仔细包装易损的指南针。
The minister had a packed schedule. 部长日程排得很满。

synonyms.example: The street was crowded with tourists. 街上挤满了游客。
synonyms.usage: be packed with 程度比 be crowded with 更强，'挤得满满的'；packed 还可接抽象物（packed with information 信息量大），crowded 一般只指人多。

synonyms.example: The room was filled with smoke. 房间里满是烟。
synonyms.usage: be filled with 泛指'装满/充满'，主语内外皆可；be packed with 强调塞得紧、密度大。三者都作表语：packed/crowded/filled + with。

advancedExpressions.expression: pack sth in/into...；be packed with；packed tightly；a pack of...；pack up；unpack
advancedExpressions.example: The hall was packed with fans. 大厅里挤满了歌迷。

advancedExpressions.expression: a pay/salary package 薪酬待遇（课件）/ packaged food 包装食品（课件）/ a packet of crisps 一袋薯片 / do the packing 收拾行李
advancedExpressions.example: The company offers a generous salary package. 这家公司提供优厚的薪酬待遇。

advancedExpressions.expression: be packed with = be crowded with = be filled with = be full of
advancedExpressions.example: The museum is packed with visitors every weekend. 博物馆每个周末都挤满游客。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Put warm clothes in your bag for the voyage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Pack warm clothes for the voyage.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 pack 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Fans filled the small stadium completely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Fans packed the small stadium.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 pack 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: 餐厅里每天人很多。The restaurant ____ ____ every day.
classPractice.note: be packed 挤满人；every day 表习惯用一般现在时（课件答案区另见 was packed，按语法以 is packed 为准）。

classPractice.question: 这本书信息丰富。The book ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: be packed with... 满是……，可接抽象名词。

classPractice.question: 装几件厚衣服在行李箱里。____ a few warm clothes ____ your suitcase.
classPractice.note: pack sth in/into... 把……装进……。

classPractice.question: 我要去中国度假，正在打包衣服。I'm going to go on a holiday to China and I'm ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: pack one's clothes 打包衣服；现在进行时。

translation: adj. 相反的，相对立的；截然不同的
original_sentence: Contrary to popular history books, most academic books tend to adopt a more analytical and serious approach!to studying history.
definitionEn: opposite in nature, direction, or meaning

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 相反的，相对立的；截然不同的
uncommonMeanings.example: The two scholars reached contrary conclusions. 两位学者得出了相反的结论。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: the contrary 相反的事实/情况（用于 on the contrary, to the contrary, quite the contrary）
uncommonMeanings.example: Quite the contrary—he loves history. 恰恰相反——他热爱历史。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 熟词僻义：（读 /kənˈtreəri/）执拗的，爱唱反调的（英式口语）
uncommonMeanings.example: She's a contrary child who never does as told. 她是个爱唱反调的孩子，从不听话。

posExamples.sentence: The evidence suggests the contrary. （课堂例句·证据表明情况恰恰相反。）
Contrary to expectations, the voyage succeeded. （课堂例句·与预期相反，航行成功了。）
The two witnesses gave contrary accounts. （课堂例句·两名证人的说法相互矛盾。）

wordForms.noun: the contrary 相反（的事实）
wordForms.adjective: contrary 相反的
wordForms.adverb: contrarily 相反地（少用，多用 on the contrary 代替）
wordForms.other: 发音贴士：常义'相反的'重音在第一音节 /ˈkɒntrəri/；表'执拗的'重音移到第二音节 /kənˈtreəri/。

idioms.translation: 恰恰相反（独立插入语，否定前句、引出相反说法）
idioms.example: It wasn't a failure. On the contrary, it was a success. 那不是失败。恰恰相反，是成功。

idioms.translation: 相反的/地（多作后置定语修饰 evidence/proof 等）
idioms.example: There is no proof to the contrary. 没有相反的证据。
He isn't lazy—quite the contrary. 他不懒——恰恰相反。

collocations.translation: 与通俗历史书相反（课文原句）
collocations.example: Contrary to popular history books, most academic books tend to adopt a more analytical and serious approach to studying history. 与通俗历史书相反，多数学术书籍倾向于采取更具分析性、更严肃的方法来研究历史。
They hold contrary opinions on this issue. 他们在这个问题上持相反的观点。

collocations.translation: 【课件】与普遍的看法相反（= Unlike）
collocations.example: Contrary to popular belief, a desert can be very cold. 与普遍看法相反，沙漠可能非常冷。

collocations.translation: 【课件】相反的证据（to the contrary 作后置定语）
collocations.example: Unless there is evidence to the contrary, we ought to believe them. 除非有相反的证据，我们应该相信他们。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（用于纠正前述说法）相反，恰恰相反
collocations.example: I'm not ill. On the contrary, I'm very healthy. 我没生病。相反，我很健康。
The voyage was not a failure; quite the contrary. 航行并非失败，恰恰相反。
One historian expressed a contrary view. 一位历史学家提出相反观点。
No evidence proved the contrary. 没有证据证明相反。

synonyms.example: They walked in opposite directions. 他们朝相反的方向走去。
synonyms.usage: contrary 强调逻辑、观点上'相反对立'（contrary opinions/evidence to the contrary）；opposite 指方向、位置、性质上'相对/相反'，可作名词 the opposite（Hot is the opposite of cold.）。

synonyms.example: Unlike popular belief, a desert can be very cold. 与普遍看法不同，沙漠可能很冷。
synonyms.usage: 课件标注 Contrary to = Unlike：两者都作介词短语置句首作状语；unlike 更口语，contrary to 更书面，强调'与……相反'而非仅'不同'。

synonyms.example: The witnesses gave conflicting accounts. 证人的说法相互矛盾。
synonyms.usage: conflicting 指多个说法/利益'彼此冲突'，作定语为主；contrary 指'与某一方相反'，可用于 contrary to 结构。

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析卡·on the contrary vs to the contrary vs contrary to
advancedExpressions.expression: on the contrary 独立插入语'恰恰相反'（纠正前句）；to the contrary 后置修饰名词（evidence/proof to the contrary）；contrary to + 名词 作状语'与……相反'
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to reports, the ship returned safely. 与报道相反，船安全返航了。

advancedExpressions.expression: contrary to = unlike = in contrast to/with = as opposed to
advancedExpressions.example: In contrast to the past, machines now do the work. 与过去相反，现在由机器干活。

advancedExpressions.expression: contrary opinions / contrary to popular belief / on the contrary / to the contrary / quite the contrary
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to popular belief, Pearl Harbor was not the end of the fleet. 与普遍看法相反，珍珠港并非舰队的终结。

translation: 与…相反
original_sentence: Contrary to popular history books, most academic books tend to adopt a more analytical and serious approach!to studying history.
definitionEn: opposite to or in conflict with something

posExamples.sentence: Contrary to the forecast, the sea remained calm. （课堂例句·与预报相反，海面一直平静。）
His actions were contrary to the law. （课堂例句·他的行为违反法律。）
The result is contrary to common belief. （课堂例句·结果与普遍看法相反。）

collocations.translation: 与通俗历史书相反（课文原句）
collocations.example: Contrary to popular history books, most academic books tend to adopt a more analytical and serious approach to studying history. 与通俗历史书相反，多数学术书籍倾向于采取更具分析性、更严肃的方法来研究历史。

collocations.translation: 【课件】与普遍的看法相反（= Unlike）
collocations.example: Contrary to popular belief, a desert can be very cold. 与普遍看法相反，沙漠可能非常冷。
Contrary to expectations, the voyage went smoothly. 出乎意料，航行很顺利。
Contrary to what he said, the museum was closed. 与他说的相反，博物馆关门了。
The dismissal was contrary to law. 这次解雇违反法律。
He sailed contrary to medical advice. 他不顾医嘱出海。
The claim is contrary to the evidence. 该说法与证据相悖。
The plan proceeded contrary to her wishes. 计划违背她意愿继续。

synonyms.example: Unlike his brother, he loves history. 与哥哥不同，他热爱历史。
synonyms.usage: 课件标注 Contrary to = Unlike：都置句首作状语；contrary to 强调'相反、对立'，unlike 只表'不同'，程度较弱。

synonyms.example: In contrast to the north, the south is warm. 与北方相比，南方温暖。
synonyms.usage: in contrast to 客观陈述'对比差异'；contrary to 强调'与（看法、预期）相反'，常接 belief/expectations/what 从句。

synonyms.example: He studies real history, as opposed to legends. 他研究真实历史，而非传说。
synonyms.usage: as opposed to 用于对举两个并列成分'是A而不是B'；contrary to 置句首引出'与之相反'的背景。

advancedExpressions.type: 用法卡·contrary to 的位置与搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: contrary to + 名词/what从句，常置句首作状语，后加逗号；不可直接接完整句子
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to what many believe, the Silk Road was not one road. 与许多人的看法相反，丝绸之路并非一条路。

advancedExpressions.expression: contrary to = unlike = in contrast to = as opposed to；句中亦可用 on the contrary（独立插入语）改写
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to reports, no ship was lost. 与报道相反，没有船只失事。

advancedExpressions.type: 写作套语·纠正误解开头
advancedExpressions.expression: Contrary to popular belief, ... 是议论文/说明文纠正常见误解的高分开头句式
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to popular belief, the Industrial Revolution did not benefit everyone. 与普遍看法相反，工业革命并未惠及所有人。

translation: n. 地狱；苦难的经历，悲惨的境况
original_sentence: Back to the past 39 Hell comes to Pearl Harbor Read the article about the attack on Pearl Harbor.
definitionEn: in some religions, a place of punishment after death; an extremely unpleasant situation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 地狱（与 heaven 天堂相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: Some people believe bad souls go to hell. 有人相信恶人的灵魂会下地狱。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 苦难的经历，悲惨的境况（课文标题义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Life in the trenches was hell. 战壕里的生活苦不堪言。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 口语中用于加强语气：the hell 究竟，到底
uncommonMeanings.example: What the hell is going on? 到底发生了什么？（口语，正式书面语慎用）

posExamples.sentence: The mine was a living hell during the fire. （课堂例句·火灾期间，矿井如同人间地狱。）
They went through hell to reach safety. （课堂例句·他们历尽苦难才抵达安全地带。）
What the hell happened here? （课堂例句·这里到底发生了什么？）

wordForms.noun: hell 地狱；苦难
wordForms.adjective: hellish 地狱般的，可怕的
wordForms.other: 发音 /hel/；注意：hell 在口语中常作加强语气词，高考书面表达中应避免；课文标题 Hell comes to Pearl Harbor 把'地狱'拟人化，是新闻标题常用修辞

idioms.example: When the bombs fell, all hell broke loose. 炸弹落下时，现场顿时大乱。
He told them to go to hell. 他叫他们见鬼去。
They did it just for the hell of it. 他们做这事纯粹为了好玩。

collocations.translation: 课文标题：地狱降临珍珠港（暗喻+拟人）
collocations.example: Hell comes to Pearl Harbor. 地狱降临珍珠港。
He went through hell during the war. 战争期间他经历了地狱般的磨难。
The attack turned the harbor into a living hell. 袭击把港口变成了人间地狱。
The prison camp was hell on earth. 那座战俘营是人间地狱。
We ran like hell to escape the fire. 我们拼命跑着逃离大火。
The captain raised hell over the missing log. 船长因日志丢失大发雷霆。
It was one hell of a storm. 那是一场极猛烈的风暴。
The memorial recalls the hell of war. 纪念碑让人铭记战争苦难。

synonyms.example: The journey home became a nightmare. 回家的旅程成了一场噩梦。
synonyms.usage: nightmare 指'噩梦般的经历'，可数名词，常作表语/宾语；hell 不可数，语气更重，指'地狱般的煎熬'，常用于 go through hell、a living hell 等固定搭配

synonyms.example: The war brought misery to millions. 战争给数百万人带来了苦难。
synonyms.usage: misery 是正式书面词，指持续的痛苦状态；hell 更口语化、形象化，多用于习语

advancedExpressions.expression: go through hell 受尽磨难 / a living hell 人间地狱 / all hell broke loose 顿时大乱 / like hell 拼命地
advancedExpressions.example: After the attack, all hell broke loose in the harbor. 袭击之后，港口顿时乱作一团。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文标题 Hell comes to Pearl Harbor：抽象名词 Hell 作主语被拟人化，新闻标题用一般现在时表已发生的事件
advancedExpressions.example: 对比：Disaster strikes small town. 灾难袭击小镇。（标题惯用一般现在时）

advancedExpressions.expression: Hell comes to Pearl Harbor / go through hell / a living hell / hell on earth
advancedExpressions.example: Hell comes to Pearl Harbor. 地狱降临珍珠港。

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 hell 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

translation: prep. & adv. 在（车、船、飞机等）上，上（车、船、飞机等）
original_sentence: More than 1,000 people aboard the Arizona lost their lives.
definitionEn: on or into a ship, aircraft, train, or other vehicle

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 在（车、船、飞机等）上（后接交通工具名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: There were 300 passengers aboard the ship. 船上有300名乘客。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上（车、船、飞机等）；在船（机）上（单独使用，不接宾语）

uncommonMeanings.example: Welcome aboard! You'll love working with our team. 欢迎加入！你会喜欢和我们团队共事的。

wordForms.noun: board n. 甲板；木板；董事会；膳食
wordForms.verb: board v. 登上（飞机、船、车）；boarded 已登机
wordForms.adverb: aboard 在（车、船、飞机）上（本词即副词/介词）

collocations.example: More than 1,000 people aboard the Arizona lost their lives. 亚利桑那号上1000多人丧生。

collocations.translation: （开车/开船前吆喝）请上车/船啦
collocations.example: "All aboard!" shouted the conductor. "请上车！"列车员喊道。
Two specialists came aboard the project. 两名专家加入项目。
Most passengers remained aboard. 大多数乘客留在船上。
Medical supplies were stored aboard the vessel. 医疗用品存放在船上。

synonyms.example: All the passengers on board were safe. 机上所有乘客都安全。

synonyms.example: The onboard computer recorded the fault.
synonyms.usage: aboard 作副词/介词，置于动词后或名词前不用冠词；onboard 主要作前置定语，如 onboard equipment。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·登机/在机上
advancedExpressions.expression: be aboard the plane = be on board (the plane) = have boarded the plane；go aboard = board v.
advancedExpressions.example: 【课件】He was already aboard the plane. = He had already boarded the plane. 他已经登机了。

advancedExpressions.expression: board v. 登（机/船）；n. 甲板／膳食（room and board 食宿）；boarding school 寄宿学校；boarding pass 登机牌
advancedExpressions.example: 【课件】Free room and board are provided for all hotel staff. 酒店为全体员工免费提供食宿。

advancedExpressions.example: The people aboard were rescued. 船上的人获救了。（aboard 后置定语）

translation: vt. & vi. 擦，磨，搓；（使）相互摩擦
definitionEn: to move something repeatedly over a surface while pressing; to move against something with friction

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 擦，搓，揉
uncommonMeanings.example: He rubbed his eyes sleepily. 他睡眼惺忪地揉着眼睛。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （相互）摩擦，蹭（常与 against/on 连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: The wheel is rubbing against the frame. 轮子在蹭车架。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 按摩，揉搓
uncommonMeanings.example: Give my back a rub, please. 请帮我揉揉背。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: the rub 难题，症结（源自莎士比亚，正式/文学）
uncommonMeanings.example: The plan is good; the rub is money. 计划不错，难就难在钱上。

posExamples.sentence: Rub the cloth gently over the stain. （课堂例句·用布轻轻擦拭污渍。）
The rope rubbed against the ship's side. （课堂例句·绳索摩擦着船舷。）
She rubbed her hands together for warmth. （课堂例句·她搓着双手取暖。）

wordForms.noun: rub 摩擦，按摩；rubber 橡胶；橡皮
wordForms.other: 拼写贴士：重读闭音节双写辅音再加词尾：rub→rubbed→rubbing（同 stop→stopped）；rubber 由 rub+er 构成，'用来擦的东西'→橡皮

idioms.translation: 在伤口上撒盐，雪上加霜
idioms.example: Mentioning her failure again rubbed salt into the wound. 再提她的失败无异于在伤口上撒盐。
At the party he rubbed shoulders with film stars. 在聚会上他与影星们打交道。

idioms.translation: 反复提及（令人难堪之事），哪壶不开提哪壶
idioms.example: OK, I lost—don't rub it in! 好吧我输了——别再念叨了！

idioms.idiom: rub sb up the wrong way
idioms.example: His manner rubs many colleagues up the wrong way. 他的态度让很多同事不快。

collocations.example: He rubbed his hands to keep warm. 他搓着手取暖。
She rubbed her eyes and looked again. 她揉了揉眼睛又看了一遍。
The cat rubbed its head against my leg. 猫用头蹭我的腿。
Rub the cream gently into your skin. 把乳霜轻轻揉进皮肤。
Young writers rubbed shoulders with literary masters. 年轻作家与文学大师交往。
Some of her confidence rubbed off on us. 她的自信感染了我们。
He rubbed out the wrong route. 他擦掉了错误路线。
His remark rubbed salt into the wound. 他的话使人雪上加霜。

synonyms.example: She wiped the table with a cloth. 她用抹布擦了桌子。
synonyms.usage: wipe 指用布/手'抹掉'表面污物，重在清除（wipe the table/one's tears）；rub 指来回'摩擦、揉搓'的动作本身（rub one's hands/eyes），不一定为了清洁

synonyms.example: Don't scratch the mosquito bite. 别挠蚊子叮的包。
synonyms.usage: scratch 用指甲/尖物'挠、抓'，可能留下划痕；rub 用手掌/平面'揉、搓'，力量分散

synonyms.example: She stroked the cat's fur softly. 她轻轻抚摸猫的毛。
synonyms.usage: stroke 单方向轻抚，表爱抚；rub 来回用力摩擦

advancedExpressions.expression: rub out 擦掉 / rub off (on sb) （品质、情绪）感染，传给 / rub down 擦干；打磨 / rub in 揉进；反复提及
advancedExpressions.example: Her enthusiasm rubbed off on the whole class. 她的热情感染了全班。

advancedExpressions.expression: rub 揉搓 / wipe 抹去 / scrub 用力刷洗 / polish 擦亮 / scratch 挠

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纪念碑，纪念像，纪念物（a memorial to sb 为纪念某人而建）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纪念的，追悼的（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: They attended a memorial service for the victims.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: Memorial Day（美国）阵亡将士纪念日（五月最后一个星期一）
uncommonMeanings.example: Many Americans visit cemeteries on Memorial Day.

posExamples.sentence: A memorial stands beside the harbour. （课堂例句·港口旁矗立着一座纪念碑。）
They held a memorial service for the victims. （课堂例句·他们为遇难者举行追悼会。）
The museum serves as a lasting memorial. （课堂例句·这座博物馆是一座永久纪念物。）

wordForms.noun: memorial 纪念碑；memory 记忆，回忆；memorandum/memo 备忘录
wordForms.verb: memorize 记住，背熟；commemorate 纪念（举行活动纪念）
wordForms.adjective: memorial 纪念的；memorable 难忘的，值得纪念的
wordForms.other: 词根 memor-（记忆）大家族：memory / memorize / memorable / memorial / commemorate；搭配贴士：a memorial to sb（介词用 to，不用 of/for）。

collocations.translation: 课文原句：参观纪念馆（纪念碑）
collocations.example: Each year, more than two million people visit the memorial. 每年有两百多万人参观这座纪念馆。

collocations.phrase: a lasting / permanent memorial to the victims
collocations.translation: 【课件】遇难者的永久纪念碑（介词用 to）
collocations.example: They built a lasting memorial to the victims. 他们为遇难者建了一座永久的纪念碑。
A memorial statue stands in the square. 广场上立着一座纪念像。
Flowers were laid at the war memorial. 人们在战争纪念碑前献花。

collocations.translation: 追悼会／纪念仪式（memorial 作定语）
collocations.example: A memorial service was held for the soldiers. 为士兵们举行了追悼会。
Residents erected a memorial by the shore. 居民在岸边立了纪念碑。
The tomb became a national memorial. 该陵墓成为国家纪念地。
A memorial fund supported the victims' families. 纪念基金帮助遇难者家属。

synonyms.example: The Monument to the People's Heroes stands in Tian'anmen Square. 人民英雄纪念碑矗立在天安门广场。
synonyms.usage: monument 泛指纪念碑或有历史价值的建筑遗迹（an ancient monument）；memorial 强调为纪念逝者/事件而建，且可作定语形容词（a memorial service，monument 无此用法）。两词表"为纪念……"介词都用 to：a monument/memorial to sb。

synonyms.example: The concert was a tribute to the victims.
synonyms.usage: memorial 是为纪念逝者而建的物或举行的活动；tribute 是表达敬意的言行，常用 a tribute to。

advancedExpressions.expression: in memory of sb / to the memory of sb 为纪念某人；commemorate the victory 纪念胜利；a memorial to... ……的纪念碑；mark the anniversary of... 纪念……周年
advancedExpressions.example: The hall was built in memory of those who lost their lives.

advancedExpressions.expression: memor-（记忆）：memory 记忆 → memorize 记住 → memorable 难忘的 → memorial 纪念碑/纪念的 → commemorate（com- 共同 + memor）共同记住→纪念
advancedExpressions.example: A ceremony was held to commemorate the heroes.

advancedExpressions.expression: visit the memorial / a lasting / permanent memorial to the victims / a memorial statue / a war memorial
advancedExpressions.example: Each year, more than two million people visit the memorial. 每年有两百多万人参观这座纪念馆。

sentenceUpgrade.original: A monument to remember the dead stands beside the harbour.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A memorial stands beside the harbour.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 memorial 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: They held a service to remember the victims.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: They held a memorial service for the victims.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 memorial 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: a lasting/permanent memorial ____ the ____ （遇难者的永久纪念碑）
classPractice.note: 课件原题：memorial 后接介词 to；"遇难者"victims。

classPractice.question: The statue was built as a memorial ____ those who died in the attack.
classPractice.note: a memorial to sb 固定搭配，同 a monument to sb。

classPractice.question: 每年有两百多万人参观这座纪念馆。
classPractice.answer: Each year, more than two million people visit the memorial.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；more than two million 两百多万。

translation: vi. & vt. 企盼，祈求；祈祷，祷告
original_sentence: They come to see the shadow of the ship at the bottom of Pearl Harbor, to learn about the attack, to show respect for those who had lost their lives in the attack and to pray for world peace.
definitionEn: to speak to a god in worship or to ask earnestly for something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 祈祷，祷告（pray to sb for sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Muslims pray five times a day.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 企盼，祈求（不一定与宗教有关）
uncommonMeanings.example: We're praying for good weather on sports day.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 请，请问（= please，旧式/讽刺用法，熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: What, pray, is the meaning of this?

posExamples.sentence: Families prayed for the sailors' safe return. （课堂例句·家属祈祷水手平安归来。）
She knelt beside the bed to pray. （课堂例句·她跪在床边祷告。）
We prayed that the storm would pass quickly. （课堂例句·我们祈求暴风雨尽快过去。）

wordForms.noun: prayer /preə(r)/ 祈祷；祷文，祷告词（say one's prayers 做祷告）
wordForms.other: 发音贴士：prayer 读 /preə(r)/ 一个音节滑过，不读 /ˈpreɪə/；同音词陷阱：pray 与 prey /preɪ/ 同音——prey 猎物（fall prey to 成为……的牺牲品），拼写勿混。

idioms.example: When she got the job, her prayers were answered. 她得到那份工作，祈祷应验了。

idioms.idiom: be the answer to sb's prayers
idioms.translation: 正是某人求之不得的东西（人）
idioms.example: The scholarship was the answer to his prayers. 这笔奖学金正是他求之不得的。

collocations.translation: 课文原句：为世界和平祈祷
collocations.example: They come to see the shadow of the ship at the bottom of Pearl Harbor, to learn about the attack, to show respect for those who had lost their lives in the attack and to pray for world peace. 他们来看珍珠港海底那艘军舰的影子，了解那次袭击，向在袭击中失去生命的人们致敬，并为世界和平祈祷。
They prayed to God for help. 他们向上帝祈求帮助。
She prayed to be given another chance. 她祈求能再得到一次机会。
They said prayers for the victims. 他们为遇难者祈祷。
Rain finally came—the prayers were answered. 雨终于来了——祈祷应验了。
We pray that the war will end soon. 我们祈盼战争早日结束。
He prayed for forgiveness after the plot failed. 阴谋失败后他祈求宽恕。
Families prayed in silence at the memorial. 家属在纪念碑前默祷。

synonyms.example: He begged her to stay. 他恳求她留下。
synonyms.usage: beg 的对象是人，常接 beg sb to do / beg for sth，语气急切；pray 的对象是神明或上天，pray to sb for sth，也可虚化为"企盼"（pray for good luck）。句法差异：beg sb to do 常用，pray sb to do 现代英语罕见。

synonyms.example: I hope everything goes well. 我希望一切顺利。
synonyms.usage: hope 接 that 从句或 to do，表可实现的希望；wish 接虚拟表难实现的愿望；pray (that)... 语气最强烈，带"祈求上天"色彩。

advancedExpressions.expression: pray to sb for sth 向……祈求……；pray to do sth；pray that...；say one's prayers 做祷告；answer sb's prayers 使祈祷应验；prayers for sth 为……的祈祷
advancedExpressions.example: Every night the child says his prayers before bed.

advancedExpressions.expression: pray for / long for / yearn for / be dying for（口语）都可表"渴盼"；程度：hope < long/yearn < pray（求上天）
advancedExpressions.example: People all over the world long for lasting peace.

advancedExpressions.expression: pray for world peace / pray (to sb) for sth / pray to do sth / prayers for sth
advancedExpressions.example: They come to see the shadow of the ship at the bottom of Pearl Harbor, to learn about the attack, to show respect for those who had lost their lives in the attack and to pray for world peace. 他们来看珍珠港海底那艘军舰的影子，了解那次袭击，向在袭击中失去生命的人们致敬，并为世界和平祈祷。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Families asked God for the sailors' safe return.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Families prayed for the sailors' safe return.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 pray 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: She knelt beside the bed to speak to God.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She knelt beside the bed to pray.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 pray 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question:
他们向上帝祈求帮助。
They prayed ____ God ____ help.
classPractice.note: 课件搭配 pray (to sb) for sth：to 接祈祷对象，for 接祈求内容。

classPractice.question: Their ____ (pray) for rain were finally answered.
classPractice.note: 课件讲点 The prayers were answered. 祈祷应验了；谓语 were 提示复数名词。

classPractice.question: 他们来到这里悼念逝者，并为世界和平祈祷。
classPractice.answer: They come here to show respect for the dead and to pray for world peace.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块 pray for world peace；show respect for 悼念，向……致敬。

translation: n. 一段经历，片段；一集
definitionEn: one event or period in a series; one part of a television or radio programme

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电视剧、广播剧的）一集，一期
uncommonMeanings.example: The first episode airs next Monday.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人生或历史中的）一段经历，一个片段，插曲
uncommonMeanings.example: It was one of the strangest episodes in my life.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （疾病的）一次发作
uncommonMeanings.example: He suffered an episode of depression last year.

posExamples.sentence: The voyage was a painful episode in his life. （课堂例句·那次航行是他人生中一段痛苦经历。）
I missed the final episode of the series. （课堂例句·我错过了这部剧的最后一集。）
The book records a little-known historical episode. （课堂例句·本书记录了一段鲜为人知的历史插曲。）

wordForms.noun: episode（一集；片段）
wordForms.adjective: episodic 分集的；偶发的，片段性的
wordForms.other: 重音在第一音节 /ˈepɪsəʊd/；构词：epi-（附加，在……之上）+ -sode（进入）→“附加进来的部分”→插曲、片段。

collocations.example: I watched the latest episode of the drama last night. 我昨晚看了这部剧的最新一集。
The final episode attracted millions of viewers. 大结局吸引了数百万观众。

collocations.phrase: a tragic / dark episode in history
collocations.translation: 历史上悲惨的／黑暗的一段
collocations.example: The attack was a tragic episode in American history. 那次袭击是美国历史上悲惨的一页。

collocations.translation: 人生中的一段经历（介词用 in）
collocations.example: The voyage was an unforgettable episode in his life. 那次航行是他人生中难忘的一段经历。
The panic was a brief episode. 恐慌只是短暂插曲。
The voyage became a memorable episode in her life. 航行成为她人生中难忘一段。
Check the episode number before watching. 观看前核对集数。
He suffered an acute episode of pain. 他经历了一次急性疼痛发作。

synonyms.translation: n. 事件（尤指不寻常或不愉快的）
synonyms.example: The airport was closed after a serious incident. 发生严重事件后机场关闭了。
synonyms.usage: incident 指独立发生的"事件"，常带负面色彩（without incident 平安无事）；episode 强调是整体（人生、历史、剧集）中的一"段"，典型搭配 an episode in one's life / in history，介词用 in。

synonyms.translation: n. （人生、历史的）一段时期；（书的）一章
synonyms.example: Graduation closed a chapter in her life. 毕业为她人生的一个阶段画上句号。
synonyms.usage: chapter 与 episode 都可喻指"人生/历史的一段"，chapter 更强调可以"翻篇"的阶段（open/close a chapter）；episode 更短，像一段插曲。

advancedExpressions.expression: an episode in one's life / a chapter in one's life / a phase 阶段 / a period of... 一段时期；写作中可用 a memorable episode 替换 an unforgettable experience
advancedExpressions.example: Studying abroad was a memorable episode in her life.

advancedExpressions.expression: a series 一部剧集 / a season 一季 / an episode 一集 / the finale 大结局；an episode of + 剧名
advancedExpressions.example: The new season has ten episodes.

advancedExpressions.expression: an episode of (a TV series) / the final / next episode / a tragic / dark episode in history / an episode in one's life
advancedExpressions.example: I watched the latest episode of the drama last night. 我昨晚看了这部剧的最新一集。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The voyage was a painful period in his life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The voyage was a painful episode in his life.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 episode 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: I missed the final part of the television series.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I missed the final episode of the series.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 episode 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: The bombing of Pearl Harbor was a tragic episode ____ the country's history.
classPractice.note: an episode in history/one's life，介词固定用 in。

classPractice.question: 我昨晚看了这部电视剧的最后一集。
classPractice.answer: I watched the final episode of the TV series last night.
classPractice.note: the final episode of... ……的最后一集。

classPractice.question:
用 episode / incident 的适当形式填空：
1) The police are investigating the ____.
2) That trip remains a happy ____ in my memory.
classPractice.note: incident 独立的（多为负面）事件；episode 整体中的一段经历。

translation: n. 纺织品；(textiles) 纺织业
original_sentence: This began with improvements in textile production in northern England.
definitionEn: cloth or fabric, especially when manufactured; the industry that produces cloth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纺织品，纺织物
uncommonMeanings.example: The shop sells traditional Chinese textiles.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纺织业（复数形式表行业）
uncommonMeanings.example: Thousands of people are employed in textiles.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纺织的
uncommonMeanings.example: Textile production was revolutionized by new machines.

posExamples.sentence: The region exports cotton textiles. （课堂例句·该地区出口棉纺织品。）
She works in the textile industry. （课堂例句·她在纺织业工作。）
The museum displays ancient textiles. （课堂例句·博物馆展出古代纺织品。）

wordForms.noun: textile 纺织品；texture 质地，纹理；text 文本
wordForms.other: 词根 text-（编织）：textile 纺织品、texture 质地（织出的纹理）、text 文本（"编织"出的文字）；发音 /ˈtekstaɪl/ 重音在前；表"纺织业"用复数 textiles。

collocations.translation: 课文原句：纺织生产的改进
collocations.example: This began with improvements in textile production in northern England. 这始于英格兰北部纺织生产的改进。

collocations.phrase: jobs will be lost in textiles and clothing
collocations.translation: 【课件】纺织业和服装业将失去工作岗位（textiles 复数表行业）
collocations.example: Another 75,000 jobs will be lost in textiles and clothing. 纺织业和服装业还将失去7.5万个工作岗位。
The textile industry boomed during the Industrial Revolution. 工业革命期间纺织工业蓬勃发展。
She worked in a textile mill for years. 她在纺织厂工作了多年。
New machines increased textile production. 新机器提高了纺织产量。
Textile workers demanded safer factories. 纺织工人要求更安全的工厂。
The canal expanded the textile trade. 运河促进了纺织品贸易。
She studied traditional textile design. 她学习传统纺织品设计。

synonyms.example: The dress is made of cotton fabric. 这条裙子是棉布做的。
synonyms.usage: fabric 指具体的布料（可数/不可数），还可喻指"结构"：the fabric of society 社会结构；cloth 布（不可数，一块布 a piece of cloth）；textile 较正式，多作统称"纺织品"或作定语（textile industry/production），复数表行业。

synonyms.example: The mill produces cotton cloth.
synonyms.usage: textile 是技术/行业用语，可指纺织品或作定语 textile industry；cloth 是制衣或擦拭用的具体布料。

advancedExpressions.expression: cloths 布料（cloth 的复数）／clothes（各类）衣服（恒为复数，无单数）／clothing 衣着，衣服的总称（不可数，较正式）；课件与 textiles and clothing 同组讲解
advancedExpressions.example: It's important to wear formal clothing in the workplace.

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·工业革命词块（课件同页）
advancedExpressions.expression: textiles and clothing 纺织业和服装业；industrial output 工业产量；far-reaching reforms 影响深远的改革——描述工业革命的高频词块
advancedExpressions.example: Statistics show the largest drop in industrial output for ten years.

advancedExpressions.expression: improvements in textile production / jobs will be lost in textiles and clothing / the textile industry / a textile factory / mill
advancedExpressions.example: This began with improvements in textile production in northern England. 这始于英格兰北部纺织生产的改进。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The region exports manufactured cotton cloth.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The region exports cotton textiles.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 textile 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: She works in the industry that produces cloth.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She works in the textile industry.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 textile 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: 用 cloths / clothes / clothing 填空：It's important to wear formal ____ in the workplace.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：formal clothing 正式着装，clothing 为不可数总称；课件将此辨析与 textiles and clothing 同组讲解。

classPractice.question: I'm going to go on a holiday to China and I'm ____ ____ ____. （打包我的衣服）
classPractice.note: 课件原题："各类衣服"用 clothes（恒为复数）。

classPractice.question: The Industrial Revolution began with improvements in ____ (textile) production in northern England.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：textile 作定语修饰 production，用单数。

classPractice.question: 纺织业和服装业还将失去7.5万个工作岗位。
classPractice.answer: Another 75,000 jobs will be lost in textiles and clothing.
classPractice.note: 课件例句：表行业用复数 textiles；in + 行业。

translation: vt. & n. vt. 改进，改良，改革 n. 改革，改良
definitionEn: to improve a system by making changes; a change intended to improve a system

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 改革，改进，改良（制度、法律、组织等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The law needs to be reformed.（课件例句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （使）改过自新，（使）悔改（熟词僻义，课件义项）
uncommonMeanings.example: He has promised to reform. 他已承诺改过自新。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 改革，改良（可数或不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: far-reaching reforms in education 教育领域的深远改革（课件词块）

posExamples.sentence: The government plans to reform the tax system. （课堂例句·政府计划改革税制。）
The new law introduced major prison reforms. （课堂例句·新法律推行了重大的监狱改革。）
Campaigners called for educational reform. （课堂例句·活动人士呼吁教育改革。）

wordForms.noun: reform 改革；reformer 改革者；reformation 改革（the Reformation 欧洲宗教改革）
wordForms.adjective: reformed 经过改革的；已改过自新的
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-（再、重新）+ form（形成、塑造）→ 重新塑造 → 改革；同族词：form, formation, transform, uniform；动词、名词同形，重音都在第二音节 /rɪˈfɔːm/

collocations.translation: 机器设计得到改进（课文原句，被动语态）
collocations.example: Machine designs were reformed and the textile output increased considerably. 机器设计得到改进，纺织品产量大幅增加。
The government carried out far-reaching reforms in education. 政府在教育领域推行了影响深远的改革。
The law needs to be reformed. 这部法律需要改革。
He has promised to reform. 他已承诺改过自新。
They introduced economic reforms in the 1980s. 他们在20世纪80年代推行了经济改革。
China's reform and opening-up began in 1978. 中国的改革开放始于1978年。
Economic reform increased factory output. 经济改革提高了工厂产量。
The reform movement gained support. 改革运动获得支持。

synonyms.example: We must improve the quality of education.
synonyms.usage: improve 泛指'使更好'，宾语范围广（技能、质量、健康等）；reform 特指对制度、法律、教育等做系统性变革，宾语多为 system/law/education，且 reform 可作不及物动词表'改过自新'，improve 无此义

synonyms.example: The Industrial Revolution transformed British society.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 家庭手工业（工人在自己家中小规模进行的生产）
uncommonMeanings.example: Cloth-making was once a cottage industry in Britain.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）小规模却红火的行业（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Reviewing gadgets online has become a cottage industry.

posExamples.sentence: Families earned extra income through a cottage industry producing lace. （课堂例句·家庭通过家庭蕾丝作坊增加收入。）
The craft supports a local cottage industry. （课堂例句·这门手艺支撑着当地家庭手工业。）
Modern platforms have revived some cottage industries. （课堂例句·现代平台复兴了一些家庭式产业。）

wordForms.noun: cottage industry 家庭手工业（可数，复数 cottage industries）
wordForms.other: 合成名词：cottage（小屋）+ industry（工业）→ 在家中进行的小规模工业；复数 cottage industries；注意 industry 另有'勤奋'义，industrious 勤奋的 ≠ industrial 工业的

collocations.phrase: the shift from the cottage industry to the factory system
collocations.translation: 从家庭手工业到工厂制的转变（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The shift from the cottage industry to the factory system, combined with the introduction of new machines, new energy sources and new forms of transport, promoted economic growth and expanded world trade. 从家庭手工业到工厂制的转变，加上新机器、新能源和新型交通方式的引入，促进了经济增长，扩大了世界贸易。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 以家庭手工业形式起步
collocations.example: Weaving began as a cottage industry. 织布最初是一种家庭手工业。
Lace-making became a home-based cottage industry. 花边制作成为家庭手工业。
Tourism revived the traditional cottage industry. 旅游业复兴了传统家庭手工业。
Small loans support a local cottage industry. 小额贷款扶持当地家庭手工业。
Factories replaced cottage-industry production. 工厂取代了家庭作坊生产。
Cottage-industry workers set their own hours. 家庭手工业者自行安排工时。
The craft developed into a cottage industry. 这门手艺发展成家庭手工业。

synonyms.example: Many traditional crafts survive as home-based industries.
synonyms.usage: 同义说法；cottage industry 是固定历史术语，特指工业革命前分散在家庭中的手工生产，与 the factory system（工厂制）相对

synonyms.example: The craft grew into a small-scale industry.
synonyms.usage: cottage industry 特指家庭作坊式生产；small-scale industry 只说明规模小，不一定在家生产。

advancedExpressions.expression: The shift from A to B, combined with..., promoted...：combined with 为过去分词短语作插入成分（后置定语），不影响主谓；主语中心词是 The shift，谓语为 promoted
advancedExpressions.example: The shift from the cottage industry to the factory system, combined with the introduction of new machines, new energy sources and new forms of transport, promoted economic growth and expanded world trade.（课文原句）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·工业革命术语
advancedExpressions.expression: the cottage industry 家庭手工业 / the factory system 工厂制 / the textile industry 纺织业 / mass production 大规模生产
advancedExpressions.example: The factory system gradually replaced the cottage industry.

advancedExpressions.expression: the shift from the cottage industry to the factory system / begin as a cottage industry / home-based cottage industry / traditional cottage industry
advancedExpressions.example: The shift from the cottage industry to the factory system, combined with the introduction of new machines, new energy sources and new forms of transport, promoted economic growth and expanded world trade. 从家庭手工业到工厂制的转变，加上新机器、新能源和新型交通方式的引入，促进了经济增长，扩大了世界贸易。（课文原句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Families earned extra income from small-scale lace production at home.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Families earned extra income through a cottage industry producing lace.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 cottage industry 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The craft supports small home-based local businesses.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The craft supports a local cottage industry.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 用 cottage industry 替换宽泛表达，使语义更准确、凝练。

classPractice.question: 从家庭手工业到工厂制的转变促进了经济增长。The ____ from the cottage industry ____ the factory system promoted economic growth.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块：the shift from A to B 从A到B的转变

classPractice.question: The shift from the cottage industry to the factory system, ____ (combine) with the introduction of new machines, new energy sources and new forms of transport, promoted economic growth and expanded world trade.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；combine 与 the shift 为被动关系，用过去分词 combined with 作插入成分，谓语仍是 promoted
